button.name: Deltarune Save Editor
button.author: vibecoderanon
button.description: Native Nintendo Switch save editor for DELTARUNE Chapter 1 & 2. Features GameMaker DS-list hex codec support, JKSV and Checkpoint auto-detection, party stat modifications (Kris, Susie, Ralsei, Noelle), Dark Dollars and Light World money boosts, Chapter 2 recruits roster auto-completer, and secret boss flag toggles.
